acceptanceCriteria.text: Workbench opens the E-drive external source/runtime home and uses browser UI as the primary acceptance surface.
A normal low-conflict demand reaches two same-Change worker worktrees, Codex artifacts, worker validation/audit evidence, and a ready SchedulerIntegrationCandidate.
The user manually confirms planning.scheduler.integration-check.run; raw scheduler and integration apply/discard actions are not auto-consumed.
A real aggregate validation or audit failure, not marker-only deletion, triggers Codex-backed IntegrationFix in the integration fix checkout.
IntegrationFix records Codex run artifacts, repaired patch evidence, repaired diff hash, attempt status, and rerun aggregate validation/audit evidence.
The repaired result stops at human integration apply/discard or records a clearly classified blocker.
Source root is not mutated before explicit human integration apply; before/after source git status is recorded.

tasks.text: Create active change scope and handoff pointers.
Build and prepare the E-drive external sandbox with dependencies and real aggregate validation setup.
Drive the real Workbench UI path to same-Change scheduler workers and ready integration candidate.
Manually confirm IntegrationCheck and capture aggregate failure plus Codex-backed IntegrationFix evidence.
Verify post-repair aggregate validation/audit and final human gate or blocker classification.
If needed, patch only the blocker owner and run targeted verification.
Complete review coverage, handoff docs, Harness checks, close, and git settlement.
